group.title: An incomplete equipment delivery
group.passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — ORDER CONFIRMATION
BrightDesk Supplies — Order BD-4821
Customer: Harbour Learning Centre
Delivery address: 18 Mill Road
Requested delivery: June 7, before noon

12 adjustable desk lamps, model L8, at $42 each: $504
12 clamp bases, model C2, at $9 each: $108
Standard delivery: $28
Total: $640

The L8 lamp is supplied with a weighted base. The optional C2 clamp allows attachment to the edge of a desk, freeing the desk surface. Delivery drivers cannot assemble equipment. Report shortages within three business days of delivery, quoting the order number. Unopened goods may be returned within 30 days; return freight is paid by the customer unless the item is defective.

DOCUMENT 2 — EMAIL
To: BrightDesk Customer Care
From: Priya Shah, Harbour Learning Centre
Date: June 7
Subject: BD-4821 — missing items

The driver arrived at 10:20 this morning, and all twelve lamps were in the shipment. However, the carton contained only eight C2 clamps. The packing slip lists twelve, so please investigate the discrepancy and send the remaining four as soon as possible. We need every lamp clamped to a desk before our computer course begins on June 12. The lamps work correctly, and we do not wish to return them. Please send the missing clamps to the original address, but mark the parcel for the second-floor reception desk. Our maintenance team will install them.
